CardDescription.DefaultText:
Bought from traders; needs medium acidity, medium hydration and medium to high structure. Produces the most yield on high nutrients during spring. 

Edible grain, long lasting and useful for making bread and beer.
CardDescription.Text: 从商人处购得；需要中等酸度、中等湿度、中低养分和中高土质。春季高养分下产量最高。\n\n持久耐储的可食用谷物，可制作面包和啤酒。
CardDescription.zh: 从商人处购得；需要中等酸度、中等湿度、中低养分和中高土质。春季高养分下产量最高。\n\n持久耐储的可食用谷物，可制作面包和啤酒。
CardDescription.en: Bought from traders; needs medium acidity, medium hydration and medium to high structure. Produces the most yield on high nutrients during spring. \n\nEdible grain, long lasting and useful for making bread and beer.
CardDescription.ja: 商人から購入できる。中程度の酸性度、中程度の水分、中〜高い土壌構造を必要とする。春に高栄養の土壌で最も多く収穫できる。\n\n食用穀物で保存性が高く、パンやビール作りに役立つ。

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Found: Bought from Traders. Growth Needs: Mid Acidity, Mid Hydration and Mid to High Structure. Produces the most yield on High Nutrients during Spring. Benefits: Staple Food.
CardHelpSection.Text: 获取：从商人处购得。 需求：中等酸度、中等湿度和中高土质。春季高养分下产量最高。 效果：主食。
CardHelpSection.zh: 获取：从商人处购得。 需求：中等酸度、中等湿度和中高土质。春季高养分下产量最高。 效果：主食。
CardHelpSection.en: Found: Bought from Traders. Growth Needs: Mid Acidity, Mid Hydration and Mid to High Structure. Produces the most yield on High Nutrients during Spring. Benefits: Staple Food.
CardHelpSection.ja: 入手：商人から購入。 生育条件：中程度の酸性度、中程度の水分、中〜高い土壌構造を必要とする。春に高栄養の土壌で最も多く収穫できる。 用途：主食。
